subject: Request: Short-term coverage letter + evidence handover for SOC 2 gap - CirrusHealth
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cirrushealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@cirrushealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term coverage request between SOC 2 report period and current date

Hi Rachel,

We reviewed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-12-31) and have a gap between that report end date and our vendor onboarding cutover (we go live 2027-06-10). Our compliance team is asking for a short-term coverage letter (bridge letter) that affirms no material control changes since the report end date and an index of evidence you can provide (high-level items: SOC 2 report, evidence map, KMS attestations, uptime SLA docs).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 1) a signed bridge letter for the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-06-10, 2) a list of available evidence we can collect for our SOC review, and 3) an expected delivery timeline? We prefer to have the bridge letter signed within the next 10 business days to keep our procurement schedule.

Attachments: Cirrus_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf) — our standard security intake; Evidence_Index_Cirrus.xlsx (xlsx) — fields we populate once you confirm available items.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Sr. InfoSec Manager, CirrusHealth
maya.patel@cirrushealth.com
From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cirrushealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage request between SOC 2 report period and current date

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We can help.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a signed bridge letter to cover 2027-01-01 through 2027-06-10 (subject to internal review).
- We can provide a scoped evidence package: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), control testing index (spreadsheet), KMS key rotation logs summary, and uptime/SLA summary. Some raw logs require an NDA/addendum — I’ll flag those if needed.
- Target: draft bridge letter in 5 business days, final signed letter within 10 business days, evidence index delivered within 7 business days.

Neha — can you confirm the availability of the KMS rotation summary and whether we need a redaction pass on any vendor invoices?
Karthik — please confirm if we can include a short KM (key management) attestation and a one-page description of compensating controls for the period post-2026-12-31.

Maya — I attached our bridge letter draft and an evidence checklist to speed review. If Cirrus needs DocuSign for signature we can do that — otherwise I'll route internal signatures and return a signed PDF.

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Draft.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
From: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cirrushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage request between SOC 2 report period and current date

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 11:04 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Neha — can you confirm the availability of the KMS rotation summary and whether we need a redaction pass on any vendor invoices?

Thanks Rachel — confirming:
- SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-12-31) is ready to share as a signed PDF (no redactions required).
- KMS rotation summary: available as an export covering 2027-01-01 to present. We can provide a summarized CSV (key IDs, rotation timestamps, rotation policy reference). Full key material or plaintext secrets will not be shared.
- Vendor invoices: we recommend sharing redacted invoices (vendor name and amount only) if Cirrus needs proof of outsourced SOC-related controls; otherwise we can provide a vendor-control attestation.
- Compensating controls narrative: I can draft a one-page statement describing process continuity, emergency patch cadence, and temporary mitigations applied since 2027-01-01.

Timeline: I will prepare the evidence index and KMS summary by Tue 25 May 2027 and circulate for internal legal/security sign-off. Once we land the bridge letter language with Cirrus, we can route for signature via DocuSign.

--
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cirrushealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@cirrushealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term coverage request between SOC 2 report period and current date

Rachel / Neha — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. Couple of follow-ups:
1) DocuSign is preferred for our records. Please send the DocuSign link for the final bridge letter.
2) Our procurement team will accept the redacted vendor invoices if you prefer to redact; otherwise the vendor-control attestation is fine.
3) Can you include a one-paragraph statement in the bridge letter that there have been no material control changes affecting the security category since 2026-12-31? That will satisfy our auditor check.

If you hit your timelines (draft by 5 business days, final in 10) we should be able to close procurement before our 2027-06-10 go-live. Please send the draft evidence index when available and the DocuSign link for signatures.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft.

Maya Patel
Sr. InfoSec Manager, CirrusHealth
maya.patel@cirrushealth.com
